title: 第26章 破脉第27章 斥责
content_zh:
残阳如血，将白露镇的青瓦屋檐染成赤色。
许星遥站在一家药铺后院，冰棘藤从地窖裂缝中蜿蜒而出，藤尖卷着的黑魂草种子还在渗出粘稠的黑液。
他机械地将毒种封入寒玉匣，这是五日来查封的第七十三家药铺。
接到周师兄失踪的消息已经五日了，这五日，他只想快些完成所有任务，快些腾出时间去寻找周师兄。
腰间的传讯玉牌又一次无声震动。
不用看也知道是瑶溪歌的询问，自周若渊失踪那日起，这已是第十七道未回复的传讯。
许星遥下意识摸向怀中，那半截染血的箫穗仿佛烙铁般灼烧着胸口。
“许师兄……”
同队的年轻弟子欲言又止，目光扫过他袖口干涸的血迹，那是昨夜救治蛊毒发作的孩童时沾染的。
许星遥突然剧烈咳嗽起来，连日的灵力透支让喉间泛起腥甜。
他抹去唇角血丝，望着西沉的红日，晚霞中似乎浮现出周若渊持箫而立的身影。
“走，下一家。”
暮色渐沉，归途的林间小径上，许星遥突然停下脚步。
惊飞的麻雀扑棱着翅膀掠过树梢，在夕阳中投下细碎的剪影。
“韩师兄。”
他的声音像是被砂纸磨过，手指缓缓抚过腰间玉牌，“我要离队半日。”
韩冰猛地转身，玄霜剑鞘撞在青石上发出脆响。
只见许星遥指尖的冰棘藤正将宗门玉牌层层缠绕，藤蔓分泌的汁液在牌面凝成霜纹，化作一枚冰茧。
“你可知擅自离队是何罪名？”
韩冰一把扣住他手腕，声音压得极低却字字如冰，“轻则鞭刑三十，重则……”

他指尖发力，却在触及对方脉门时陡然松开——许星遥的灵力竟已枯竭至此。
“我知道。
眼下古邑城基本事了，我只能寻这个时间出去。”
许星遥将冰茧塞进韩冰手中，冰棘藤瞬间将其冻成坚冰，“若天亮后我未归，你就捏碎它，里面的传讯符会告诉李长老是我擅自离队。”
韩冰的瞳孔微微收缩。
冰茧里除了玉牌，还有许星遥这些天改良的所有解毒配方，这个动作的含义再明显不过。
“为了周若渊？”
韩冰再次压低声音，“那日草偶说的话，我也听见了，可你现在的状态……”
话到一半戛然而止，他看见许星遥喉结滚动着咽下口血沫。
许星遥没有回答，只是将腰间的洞箫玉佩系得更紧了些。
糖球从他领口钻出，小兽的眼睛在夕阳下泛着幽光。
“我会把队伍安全带回古邑城。”
韩冰最终转过身去，手中的玄霜剑在空中划出冰蓝色的轨迹，“但若天亮后还不见你人影……”
他剑尖轻挑，将三枚玄霜符钉入许星遥肩头，“这能暂时掩盖你的气息。”
“多谢。”
许星遥的身影已经消失在林中，只有两个字飘回来。
李师兄的脚步声由远及近：“许师弟这是……”
“去查最后一家药铺。”
韩冰侧身挡住视线，手中冰茧已隐入袖里乾坤。
content_en:
The setting sun is like blood, dyeing the blue tile eaves of Bailu Town red.
Xu Xingyao stood in the backyard of a medicine shop. Icethorn vines snaked out from the cracks in the cellar, and the black soul grass seeds curled at the tips of the vines were still oozing thick black liquid.
He mechanically sealed the poisonous seeds into the cold jade box. This was the seventy-third drug shop sealed in the past five days.
It had been five days since he received the news that Senior Brother Zhou was missing. During these five days, he just wanted to complete all the tasks quickly and make time to find Senior Brother Zhou.
The jade communication medal around his waist vibrated silently again.
You don't need to look to know that this is Yao Xige's inquiry. Since the day Zhou Ruoyuan disappeared, this is the seventeenth unanswered summons.
Xu Xingyao subconsciously touched his arms, and the blood-stained half of the flute tassel burned his chest like a soldering iron.
"Senior Brother Xu..."
The young disciple in the same team hesitated to speak and glanced at the dried blood on his sleeves, which was stained when he treated a child suffering from poisonous poison last night.
Xu Xingyao suddenly coughed violently, and the overdraft of his spiritual power for the past few days left a fishy sweet taste in his throat.
He wiped away the bloodshot eyes from the corners of his lips and looked at the setting red sun. Zhou Ruoyuan's figure standing in the sunset seemed to emerge, holding a flute.
"Let's go to the next one."
As dusk fell, Xu Xingyao suddenly stopped on the forest path on his way home.
The frightened sparrows fluttered across the treetops, casting tiny silhouettes in the sunset.
"Senior Brother Han."
His voice sounded like it had been polished by sandpaper, and his fingers slowly touched the jade plaque at his waist, "I'm leaving the team for half a day."
Han Bing turned around suddenly, and the Xuanshuang sword scabbard made a crisp sound when it hit the bluestone.
I saw the ice thorn vines on Xu Xingyao's fingertips wrapping around the sect's jade card. The juice secreted by the vines condensed into frost patterns on the card surface, turning into an ice cocoon.
"Do you know what the crime of leaving the team without permission is?"
Han Bing grabbed his wrist and spoke in a very low voice, but his words were as clear as ice, "It can range from thirty floggings to thirty years of punishment, or..."
He exerted force with his fingertips, but suddenly let go when he touched the opponent's veins - Xu Xingyao's spiritual power had been exhausted to this point.
"I know.
Now that things are almost done in Guyi City, I can only find this time to go out. "
Xu Xingyao stuffed the ice cocoon into Han Bing's hand, and the ice thorn vine instantly froze it into solid ice. "If I don't return after daybreak, crush it. The communication talisman inside will tell Elder Li that I left the team without authorization."
Han Bing's pupils shrank slightly.
In addition to the jade tablets, the ice cocoon also contains all the detoxification formulas that Xu Xingyao has improved these days. The meaning of this action is obvious.
"For Zhou Ruoyuan?"
Han Bing lowered his voice again, "I heard what the grass puppet said that day, but your current state..."
The words came to an abrupt end when he saw Xu Xingyao's Adam's apple rolling and swallowing blood.
Xu Xingyao didn't answer, but tied the jade pendant around his waist tighter.
The candy ball came out of his collar, and the little beast's eyes glowed dimly in the sunset.
"I will bring the team safely back to Guyi City."
Han Bing finally turned around, and the Xuan Shuang Sword in his hand drew an icy blue trajectory in the air, "But if I still don't see you after daybreak..."
He raised the tip of his sword lightly and nailed three Xuanshuang Talismans into Xu Xingyao's shoulders, "This can temporarily cover up your aura."
"Thank you."
Xu Xingyao's figure had disappeared into the forest, and only two words floated back.
Senior Brother Li's footsteps came closer and closer: "Junior Brother Xu, this is..."
"Check the last drug store."
Han Bing turned sideways to block his sight, and the ice cocoon in his hand had disappeared into Qiankun's sleeve.
